label: I q.18 a.2 co. and ad 2 — Life properly signifies being of a nature that acts from itself
locator: I q.18 a.2 co. and ad 2
interpretation: Aquinas distinguishes the substantial predication of living from the less proper use of life for the operations from which it is named. His reply identifies as works of life those whose principles are in the agents, so they can bring themselves into those operations.
attribution: The passage states that life properly signifies the being of a substance whose nature enables it to move itself or bring itself to operation, which is the premise.
